## What changed?

Describe the problem and the smallest useful change. Identify V2, V3, or repository tooling.

## Evidence

List the exact commands run and results. Distinguish local compilation/tests from semantic checks or historical server evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Tests and documentation updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Synthetic rehearsal checked if onboarding/pipeline code changed.
- [ ] No credentials, account/session identifiers, private prompts, or raw captures included.
- [ ] Candidate/source provenance preserved; no new server-verification claim without evidence.
- [ ] No live challenge or paid provider calls added to CI.
